# S4.16a — C1 model-router depth + model-plane cache depth

- **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/079_S4.16a__router-c1.md`
- **Branch:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.16a` (stacked on
  `svitali/harnessharness-s4.15`)
- **Requirement:** R-2.3.2 C1 · R-2.3.3 (AC-15 leg) ·
  R-2.3.4 C1 slice
- **Closes:** AC-R-2.3.2-{10,11,12} executable legs ·
  AC-R-2.3.3-15 · AC-R-2.3.4-{5,7} projection halves
- **Deferred:** AC-R-2.3.4-12 (K6 semantic cache + verifier)
  → `DF-S4.16a-1`, owned by S5.1 (explicit ticket scope;

- **ADR:** ADR-0309.

## Gap analysis (existing seams vs ticket scope)

Surveyed before implementation; the seam map:

| AC/leg | Found | Missing |
|---|---|---|
| C0 routing | `select`, `RoutingPolicy{static, role_table}`, `RoutingRefusal`, `BudgetPort`, `RouteCandidate` | the C1 policy kinds (`fallback_chain`, `capability_filter`, `cost_cap`, `latency_cap`, `quality_target`, `health_aware`), `learned` refusal |
| evidence seams | — | `RoutingViews{pricing, quality_prior, migration}` + `HealthView`/`project_health`/`TargetHealth`/`TableHealth` stats; fail-closed defaults (`NoPricing`/`NoQualityPrior`/`NoMigration`/`NoHealth`) |
| retry-vs-reroute | error-class vocabulary, `error_actions` in the policy shape | `on_attempt_failed` + `AttemptState` + `AttemptDisposition{Retry, CompactThenRetry, Reroute, GiveUp}` + `GiveUpReason`; `ErrorAction::then` chaining; release-before-reserve |
| G-3/G-5/G-6 | guard names in the refusal sum | executable guards: migration-loss projection bound, `NoPrice`, lifted-preference attenuation |
| lift/lower | — | `lower`/`lift` MCP/ACP preference round-trip with `no_slot` loss reporting (AC-R-2.3.2-12) |
| explain | `model.route.decided`/`model.rerouted` payloads | `explain` — the trace-viewer fold over route decisions and reroutes |
| cache projection | `expect_cache_state`, `CacheCallFact`, `MissReason` | `CacheCallFact.closed` (completed/terminal/in-flight split); `project_cache_view` — the IR-1 fold over the durable prefix with version-stamp attribution |
| ensembles | `EnsembleProcedure` shape, `MatchSpec`/`ArmSpec` | `run_ensemble` executor (k routed members, one verdict, one slice); `ArmSpec::ensemble_k` + `RefusalReason::EnsembleKvs1` (AC-R-2.3.2-10) |
| effort | `effort_ladder`/`effort_step_up_admissible`/`effort_change` helpers | AC-R-2.3.3-15 test legs (capability-unmet pre-existing; ladder/step-up + `parameter_change` invalidation added) |
| K6 semantic cache | `model.cache.resolved{kind: semantic}` shape | the component itself — **C2-staged, owned by S5.1** (OQ-312) → `DF-S4.16a-1` |

## Build log

- **hh-gateway** (`src/router.rs`, `src/cache.rs`,
  `src/lib.rs`, `tests/model_plane.rs`,
  `tests/golden_streams.rs`):
  - `select_with` + `RoutingViews` — the C1 selection entry
    point: policy-family candidate selection over the sealed
    `ModelRoleTable`, capability/migration/pricing/latency/
    quality/health/preference filters, deterministic verdicts
    per candidate, typed refusals (`PolicyInvalid` for C4
    `learned` — never a silent `static` fallthrough).
  - `HealthView` + `project_health` — `TargetHealth`/
    `TableHealth` stats folded from attempt outcomes;
    `health_aware` ranks by failure rate with cooldown.
  - `on_attempt_failed` + `AttemptState` →
    `AttemptDisposition{Retry, CompactThenRetry, Reroute,
    GiveUp}` — `error_actions` is data (`then`-chaining,
    per-class map, defaults); `compact_then_retry` marks the
    compaction exactly once under the old profile
    (ADR-0122 d.3); `reroute` releases the live reservation
    through `BudgetPort::release` *before* `select_with`
    reserves the next target, obeys `allowed_classes[]` and
    `max_reroutes`, re-runs G-3/G-5/G-6 on the new target.
    `GiveUpReason` is the closed terminal sum.
  - `lower`/`lift` — the MCP/ACP `modelPreferences`
    projection and recovery: exact `preferences` round-trip,
    `required_capabilities`/`budget_view`/`role` reported as
    `no_slot` loss; lifted preferences exclude but never add
    candidates (G-6 attenuation — `lifted_preferences_
    attenuate_only`).
  - `explain` — folds `model.route.decided`/`model.rerouted`
    rows into the routing explanation (trace viewer seam).
  - Cache: `CacheCallFact.closed`; `CacheView` +
    `project_cache_view` — the IR-1 fold: opens on
    `model.call.requested`, closes on `completed`/`failed`
    (a failed call is terminal — never a warm basis, never an
    open sibling); version-stamp deltas attribute
    `dialect_change`/`profile_version`/`tool_set_change`/
    `definition_version`/`marker_policy`; `relowered` rows
    emit `relower` and suppress the coincident
    `profile_version` (the reroute's own reason wins);
    `compaction` on applied compactions; other
    `cache_invalidating` rows classify by class prefix —
    `context.*` → `context_edit`, `control.compute.*` →
    `parameter_change` (the AC-R-2.3.3-15 effort path).
- **hh-control** (`src/ensemble.rs` (new), `src/compute.rs`,
  `src/lib.rs`): `run_ensemble` — `EnsembleProcedure{kind:
  sample_k_vote, k}` executes exactly `k` members, each
  routed through `select_with` under its own `model_call_id`
  and reservation; `EnsembleRefusal{InvalidK, SelectRefused,
  MemberFailed}` typed; one `EnsembleReducer` verdict
  (`VoteReducer` tally); `slice_consumption` = Σ member
  charges + reducer charge; per-member route-decision
  payloads verified by test. `compute.rs`: +
  `effort_ladder_bound_and_step_up_rule` (AC-R-2.3.3-15 leg).
- **hh-budget** (`src/matchspec.rs`, `src/errors.rs`):
  `ArmSpec::ensemble_k` — the declared `EnsembleProcedure`
  member count; `validate_match` refuses k-vs-1/mixed-k under
  every mode but `matched_total` with
  `RefusalReason::EnsembleKvs1` (AC-R-2.3.2-10's
  commensurability half; CC9).
- **hh-lab** (`src/experiment.rs`, `src/exemplars.rs`):
  `ensemble_k` on the lab `ArmSpec` record with JSON
  round-trip; fixture literals propagated.
- **hh-embed** (`src/analysis_ops.rs`, `src/eval_ops.rs`,
  `tests/*`): `ensemble_k` decoded/projected through the
  embed ops; ArmSpec literals updated.
- **hh-experiment / hh-results** (`tests/*`): `ensemble_k`
  literal propagation.
- **Tests:** `hh-gateway/tests/model_plane.rs` — 18 new
  tests (26 → 44): policy kinds (fallback order, capability
  filter, cost cap reads pricing, latency cap excludes,
  quality target ranks by prior, health-aware ranking +
  projection/cooldown), migration guard, G-6 attenuation,
  lift/lower round-trip, retry→reroute, reroute bounds,
  compact-then-retry, explain fold, cache-view fold, IR-1
  version-stamp attribution, failed-call-never-warm,
  effort→`parameter_change`. `hh-control` ensemble 3/3 +
  effort ladder test. `hh-budget` `ensemble_kvs1_refuses_
  without_matched_total`.
- **ADR-0309** records the rulings: `RoutingViews` as the
  fail-closed evidence seam; retry-vs-reroute sequencing +
  release-before-reserve; `AttemptDisposition` naming split
  from `attempts::AttemptOutcome`; `project_cache_view` IR-1
  attribution order; G-6 attenuate-only; ensemble executor +
  `EnsembleKvs1` commensurability; K6 deferred to S5.1.

## Fix found by verification

- The initial quality-prior path returned `NoPrice` for an
  absent prior — corrected to a `policy_excluded` verdict
  aggregating to `ChainExhausted` (`NoPrice` is reserved for
  the pricing read itself; ADR-0309 D1).
- `AttemptOutcome` name collision with the generic
  `attempts::AttemptOutcome<T>` — the router enum is
  `AttemptDisposition` (ADR-0309 D2).

## Notes / deviations

- **`learned` refuses, never degrades** — `PolicyInvalid` at
  C1; the C4 predictor surface and its matched-total
  conditionality (AC-R-2.3.2-14) belong to the evolution
  pipeline tickets.
- **Ensemble members route independently** — a
  `sample_k_vote` may route every member to the same target;
  the attempted-set exclusion is `on_attempt_failed`'s
  mechanics, not the fan-out's (ADR-0309 D6).
- **Deferrals** — `DF-S4.16a-1` opened (K6 semantic cache +
  verifier = AC-R-2.3.4-12 → S5.1, its explicit owner; OQ-312
  design rulings due Stage 5). No rows closed.
